This sign prohibits anchoring in the area where it is installed.
This sign prohibits the movement of small watercraft in the area where it is installed.
This sign prohibits creating waves in the area where it is installed.
This sign prohibits parking, mooring and stopping in the area where it is installed.
If the field is green — headlights are on. If the field is gray — headlights are off.
When you select this button, your car will be parked in the spot where you pressed it.
If the field is green — the doors are closed. If the field is gray — the doors are open.
Turn the <font color=#67FF88>engine</font> on or off
If the field is green — the engine is on. If the field is gray — the engine is off.
Take out or insert the <font color=#67FF88>key</font>
If the field is green — the key is inserted. If the field is gray — the key is not in the ignition, which means the vehicle cannot be started.
When you select this button you can control your suspension. This is only available on a personal car if you installed it in the tuning shop.
This sign allows bus drivers to drive in this lane.
A bus or taxi stop. Regular cars may not stop within 15 meters of this sign.
This sign prohibits passing checkpoint posts without stopping. Such signs are placed at DPS posts and at border crossings.
The sign marks a dedicated ground-level pedestrian crossing where the driver must yield to pedestrians.
The sign marks the end of a built-up area. After this sign the speed limit is 90 km/h (the maximum speed outside built-up areas).
This sign tells the driver they are on a minor road and must give way to all vehicles with the right of way (including those approaching from the right).
A driver on a road with this sign is on the main road and does not have to yield to other vehicles. Valid for one intersection.
This sign sets the maximum vehicle height that can pass further down the road.
This sign limits the maximum speed in the area where it is installed.
The fastest type of road. The minimum speed on this road is 40 km/h, the maximum is 110 km/h. Stopping outside designated areas is prohibited.
This sign prohibits traffic for all vehicles, except vehicles of the company servicing this zone (truckers) and route vehicles.
This sign prohibits further movement for goods vehicle drivers.
This sign prohibits entry in the direction where it is installed. The sign does not apply to route vehicles.
This sign cancels all previous restrictions and sets the ones assigned to this stretch of road.
This sign prohibits overtaking for goods vehicle drivers.
This sign prohibits overtaking any vehicle moving along the stretch where this sign is installed.
This sign prohibits parking vehicles. Applies to one side of the road only.
This sign prohibits stopping and parking vehicles. Applies to one side of the road only.
This sign prohibits turning right. Similar prohibition signs exist for left turns and U-turns.
The sign marks a dedicated area for stopping vehicles.
This sign informs of a radar on the road. The radar can fine you — stay alert.
This sign informs of the direction of travel around the circle by means of arrows.
The sign marks the start of a built-up area. After this sign the speed limit is 60 km/h (the maximum speed inside built-up areas).
This sign requires the driver to stop their vehicle before the STOP line or before the edge of the road being crossed.
This sign only allows going straight. Similar signs exist for right, left, U-turns and other directions.
This sign informs of the direction of movement for goods vehicles.
A zone where the maximum speed of movement is limited. The zone applies until the \"End of maximum speed limit zone\" sign.

The fuses for this board have run out.
Hint: connect the voltmeter to start the check (connect the terminals)

To check the fuses, you need to inspect the board.

Using a voltmeter, connect the terminals to a voltage point and a ground point to measure how many Ohms each fuse reads.

On the right you will see the voltage you need to find to fix the fuse without ruining the board. A board can have 1 to 3 broken fuses.
You did not install the voltmeter, the new board is <font color=#FFC700>unavailable</font>.
Raise the charge level to the marked level and fix it

To fix the electric charge in the building, you need to restore their values to the marked levels.

Each gauge has its own marked level the charge must reach.

Be careful: the charge must not fill the whole gauge and must not be fixed below the marked level.
Hint: insert each bulb into the correct socket

To activate all the indicators, you need to place all the bulbs into the correct sockets.

Each indicator and bulb has a number on it; each indicator is connected to two sockets.

You need to use the bulbs to add up the number required by the indicator to activate it.

To check the <font color=#FFE455>gas lines</font>, run a <font color=#FFE455>system diagnostic</font>.

<font color=#4CDB5A>Connect the pipes</font> in the correct order so the gas flows from the <font color=#FFE455>gas station (point A)</font> to the <font color=#FFE455>gas substation (point B)</font>.

At the top you will see the <font color=#FFE455>progress</font>. <font color=#4CDB5A>Green</font> means the gas substation is <font color=#4CDB5A>working properly</font>. <font color=#FE4141>Red</font> marks <font color=#FE4141>faulty</font> gas substations.
To finish the <font color=#FFE455>diagnostic</font>, check all the <font color=#FFE455>substations</font>.
<font color=#4CDB5A>Green</font> means the gas substation is <font color=#4CDB5A>working</font>.
<font color=#FE4141>Red</font> means the gas substation is <font color=#FE4141>faulty</font>.
<font color=#FFE455>Drag</font> a pipe and insert it into the <font color=#FE4141>empty area</font>. A pipe may not land in the correct orientation. Tap the pipe once to rotate it.
Once a pipe is placed correctly, interacting with it becomes <font color=#FE4141>impossible</font>.
After the diagnostic, <font color=#FFE455>head</font> to the faulty substations and <font color=#FFE455>fix the problem</font>.

Arms Race is an event where players must kill others and receive new weapons. The first to reach the final weapon wins.
Big and Small is an event where four monster truck drivers must catch one player — the fastest racer!
A 5v5 game of 3 rounds where each team\'s goal is to deactivate the barrier and infect the enemy team\'s computer with a virus. Use microchips to raise extra defense and to infect the computer.
A 5v5 game of 3 rounds where each team\'s goal is to plant the flag and hold it at their base. Kill enemies, use ultimate abilities and win!
A game of 8 players with one shared goal — cross the finish line first! Compete with other players, look for shortcuts and overtake everyone on a powerful pit bike.
Team Battle is a game where you fight side by side with other players against your rivals! The team that scores the most kills during the game wins!
A team mini-game where one group of players must plant 4 flags at the enemy base while the other tries to stop them. Fight for territory control and cooperate with your team to win.

An exciting tournament action game where 8 skilled fighters pair up and duel to the death with Japanese katanas. The winner of each pair advances in the tournament to find the strongest and face them in the final battle.

Gift Theft is a fun activity in which a naughty thief decided to steal the presents from Santa Claus. Become the robber and try not to get caught by the Santas for 5 minutes, or be a brave Santa and get the gifts back!
Make your way through the dungeon with 10 players, overcome obstacles, find the magic ring and be the first to insert it into the emerald to become the winner!
A game where you must stay on the ice slabs, which can break at any moment. Stay alert and don\'t fall before the others.
8 players in military vehicles race on the track. The first across the finish line wins, surviving the storm of warfare.
A game where players take part in thrilling races with a variety of obstacles and boosters that help increase speed and get ahead of rivals.

An exciting racing game where players compete to reach the top of the location first, facing incredible parkour obstacles and searching for the fastest, trickiest routes to victory.
A game with two teams of Santa Clauses. The goal is to steal as many gifts as possible.\nThe team that gathers the most gifts in their sleigh within the time limit wins.
The season is open, so it\'s time to enjoy a wonderful mountain track.\nCompete in a snowmobile race, dodge obstacles and claim the title of descent champion.
A game with two teams of Santa Clauses fighting for the first 40 kills or the most kills within the time limit.\nFight with smart strategies and lead your team to victory!
Tank Battles is a game where 4 players compete for the status of the best tanker. Your task is to destroy as many tanks as possible in 3 minutes while fighting other tankers.
